what_is_missing: The address format (fields, their order and which are required) that the platform applies for each buyer's country, beyond the additional fields stated for Brazil, Kuwait, Panama, Peru and the Philippines (S02-SH-242)

The address format (fields, their order and which are required) that the checkout applies for each buyer's country, in place of S02-SH-G04, whose pages are now read: the address service's answer to an admin page holds each country's labels, formatting, required fields and zones (S02-SH-665 to S02-SH-687); the answer a buyer checkout received holds each country's name, code and phone prefix only (S02-SH-688); the Help Center and shopify.dev state the additional address and tax fields by country (S02-SH-647 to S02-SH-651, S02-SH-658, S02-SH-659, S02-SH-664), and that the Customer information settings apply to every country and market (S02-SH-653)

The address form (fields, their order and which are required) that the checkout applies for buyer countries other than the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Yemen, in place of S02-SH-G06: the held checkouts show the forms for those four (S02-SH-1012, S02-SH-1013, S02-SH-1015 to S02-SH-1018) and the checkout's own CountryDetails answers, with formatting and required-field flags, for the United States and Canada (S02-SH-1007 to S02-SH-1010); none holds the form or the checkout's answer for another country, such as Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Japan, Brazil or Italy. Italy and the United States are among the countries demo-fake-dev-store's checkout offers (S02-SH-1011); capture-plus's offers Canada, the United Kingdom and Yemen (S02-SH-1014)

Whether a store's exchange and return policy (سياسة الاستبدال والاسترجاع, an informational page) or its order cancellation setting (orders#order-cancellation) can take a value per market; the statements found set them per store (S02-SA-377, 378, 380, 386)

Whether the store's web analytics (the Google Analytics app's data stream, the Google Tag Manager app's container) or its ad pixels can take a value per market; the statements found set them per store (S02-SA-401 to 408)

Whether an app a store installs, or its settings, can take a value per market, and whether an app's supported countries (S02-SA-409 to 412) are matched against the store's country or its markets; the statements found install apps per store (S02-SA-416) and set the default SMS app per local or international messages (S02-SA-413 to 415)

Whether the notifications the store sends to the merchant and its staff (the settings page Notifications, the merchant app) can take a value per market; the statements found set them for the whole store, per notification and channel (S02-SA-417 to 420)

Whether a market, or its storefront, holds or presents a country of its own as the store's country (store_country, country); the statements found hold one store country per store, chosen at onboarding (S02-SA-011, 113, 313), the same store_country and country in the storefronts' answers (S02-SA-292; S02-SA-430, on one market's storefront), a list of countries per market (S02-SA-219), and store countries per digital card product (S02-SA-426 to 429)

(f), a setting that takes its value per market: whether the store's own address (its business address, عنوان المتجر) takes a value per market, or one for the whole store, and who sets it (S02-VP-76). The statements found give a branch's or warehouse's details and how many a plan allows (S02-SA-421, S02-SA-423, S02-SA-424), the store's website setting (basic_settings.store_website, S02-SA-422) and the pickup location carriers collect orders from (S02-SA-425); phase B's second pass found these are locations, not the store's address (b/RD3/done.tsv, S02-V-731), and none names the store's address per market.

Whether a store's exchange and return policy (سياسة الاستبدال والاسترجاع: the informational page of type return policy, and the return policy the theme editor posts as a number of days, S02-SA-443) can take a value per market; the order cancellation settings hold no market field (S02-SA-437, absence S02-SA-N01), where guest checkout's take one (S02-SA-439). Replaces S02-SA-G06, whose order cancellation half the held settings definition settles; in place of S02-SA-G06, which part A2-SA-H narrowed

Whether the notifications the merchant app (تطبيق التاجر) sends to the merchant and its staff (S02-SA-420) can take a value per market; the dashboard's notification settings hold no market field (S02-SA-438, absence S02-SA-N02), where guest checkout's take one (S02-SA-439). Replaces S02-SA-G10, whose settings page half the held settings definition settles; in place of S02-SA-G10, which part A2-SA-H narrowed

Whether an installed app's own page (/apps/id?app-id=…, which the settings center's list of installed apps opens) or its settings can take a value per market, and whether an app's supported countries (S02-SA-409 to 412) are matched against the store's country or its markets; the settings center's apps section and its list of installed apps hold no market field (absence S02-SA-N03), where guest checkout's take one (S02-SA-439); in place of S02-SA-G09, which part A2-SA-S narrowed

Whether the checkout page options (login by SMS, e-mail or WhatsApp, the login pop-up, guest checkout, one-page checkout) take a value per market or per buyer's country, or hold for the whole store: the article on them sets each in the store's settings and names no market (S02-ZD-247 to S02-ZD-253); it names a country only in the options on the customer's address (S02-ZD-143, S02-ZD-144); the markets article lists a market's own actions as adding products and customizing the theme (S02-ZD-013)

Whether the store's contact details shown to customers (the e-mail, the phone and the commercial registration number at the bottom of the store page, S02-ZD-267) take a value per market, or one value for the whole store: the article that states them is for Saudi merchants and sets them in the store's information (S02-ZD-266), and names no market; the markets article names no contact details (S02-ZD-013, S02-ZD-014); the Terms require every store to disclose its official contact means (S02-ZD-206)

Whether the inventory withdrawal priority (أولوية السحب من المخزون, the order of the store's warehouses, S02-ZD-270) takes a value per market, per sales channel or per buyer's city, or one value for the whole store: the articles that state it name no market; a warehouse takes sales channels (S02-ZD-160) and products can be shown by the customer's city (S02-ZD-161); the markets article names no warehouse (S02-ZD-013, S02-ZD-014); the API gives each location a fulfillment_priority with no description (S02-ZD-284)

How a customer's market is found, and whether the customer, the merchant or the platform sets it: the markets article says that after publishing, the customer sees the customization available according to their country (S02-ZD-024), and names no other step; the Region & Language popup lets customers change the store's language, country and city (S02-ZD-290, S02-ZD-187, S02-ZD-191), with a default city when the merchant does not require customers to select one (S02-ZD-288), and names no market; no page read says how a customer's country is found before they choose one, or whether the popup's store countries are the countries of the store's markets

Whether the identifiers of the tracking tools that the merchant adds in each app's activation field under سوق التطبيقات > تتبع الحملات (Google Analytics, Google tag manager, Facebook pixel, TikTok Pixel: S02-ZD-293 to S02-ZD-298) take a value per market, or one value for the whole store: the articles that state them name no market; the markets article names a market's details, products, prices and theme (S02-ZD-013, S02-ZD-014, S02-ZD-023) and no tracking tool

Whether the apps a store installs from سوق تطبيقات زد, and their settings, take a value per market, or one set for the whole store: the pages read state the apps activated in the store (تطبيقاتي, S02-ZD-301), with no set limit on their number (S02-ZD-300), and an installation recorded for the authorized store (S02-ZD-309); they name no market; the markets article names a market's details, products, prices and theme (S02-ZD-013, S02-ZD-014, S02-ZD-023) and no app

Whether team notifications (اشعارات الفريق: the order statuses chosen and the e-mail addresses added, S02-ZD-313 to S02-ZD-316) take a value per market, or one set for the whole store: the article names no market; the markets article names a market's details, products, prices and theme (S02-ZD-013, S02-ZD-014, S02-ZD-023) and no notification

Whether a team member's permissions (صلاحيات فريق العمل) can be limited to a market (خاصية الأسواق), and who sets such a limit: the pages read give permissions per member or group, set by the merchant or the store owner (S02-ZD-319 to S02-ZD-322, S02-ZD-326, S02-ZD-327); the permissions in the docs' List of Available Permissions are named by store entity, and none of them names markets; the markets article names a market's details, products, prices and theme (S02-ZD-013, S02-ZD-014, S02-ZD-023) and no team member or permission

Whether the store's privacy policy (الصفحات القانونية > سياسة الخصوصية, S02-ZD-213 to S02-ZD-215) or its customers' opt-outs (S02-ZD-335, S02-ZD-337) take a value per market or per buyer's country, or one for the whole store: the pages read name no market, and the Privacy Policy states its rights regardless of where you live (S02-ZD-336); the markets article names a market's details, products, prices and theme (S02-ZD-013, S02-ZD-014, S02-ZD-023) and no legal page

Whether a Zid store shows its customers cookie preferences or a cookie banner, and who sets them, the merchant or Zid: no page read names a cookie setting for the store; the Privacy Policy points to a Cookies usage section of Zid's security pages (Zid Security Section, Cookies usage) and the help centre names no cookie setting

Whether the store's working hours and closure (أوقات العمل الرسمية: closing the store fully, stopping orders, or ordering only in set hours and days, S02-ZD-340 to S02-ZD-344) take a value per market, or one for the whole store: the article names no market; the markets article names a market's details, products, prices and theme (S02-ZD-013, S02-ZD-014, S02-ZD-023) and no working hours or closure

Whether the store's time zone (المنطقة الزمنية, which the merchant chooses to show and export order times, S02-ZD-346) or a unit of weight takes a value per market, or one for the whole store: the article that names the time zone is the one on Saudi merchants' store data; the Store API gives one timezone per store (S02-ZD-032); the product API's examples give a product's weight with its unit (kg), and no page read names a store setting for units; the working hours (S02-ZD-340) name no time zone; the markets article names a market's details, products, prices and theme (S02-ZD-013, S02-ZD-014, S02-ZD-023) and no time zone or unit

(f), a setting that takes its value per market: whether the store's returns and cancellations (its exchange and return policy, سياسة الاستبدال والاسترجاع, among the legal pages; the orders' return_policy; cancelling orders) take a value per market or per buyer's country, or one for the whole store, and who sets them (S02-VP-65). The statement found, S02-ZD-226 (the account's own information, إعدادات الحساب), names no market; phase B's second pass noted it (b/RD3/done.tsv, S02-V-870). Whether the address format (which address fields show, their labels, or which are required) takes its value per buyer's country or per storefront, and who sets that value

Whether the address fields shown at checkout, and which of them are required, take their value per buyer's country or per storefront, and who sets that value: the pages read give the address fields under Settings › Account sign up form › Address Fields (S02-BC-153 to S02-BC-157); their labels and option values translatable per channel and locale through the Translations Admin GraphQL API (S02-BC-296 to S02-BC-299); the Country/State names translated by the storefront's default language (S02-BC-300); Google Autocomplete for customer addresses in five countries (S02-BC-301 to S02-BC-304); and the checkout settings configurable per storefront (S02-BC-305 to S02-BC-307), among which no address field is named. The Geography API's Get Country and List Countryʼs States pages give a country's name, codes, id and states, and no address field.

Whether the return settings under Settings › Returns (Yes, enable returns requests; Return Instructions; Return Reasons; Return Actions; Allow Store Credits) take a value per storefront or per buyer's country, other than the translation of the default return reasons and actions by each storefront's default language (S02-BC-339 to S02-BC-341); and any setting for order cancellations by the buyer. The pages read give the settings under Settings › Returns (S02-BC-330 to S02-BC-336), and none names a storefront, a channel or a country for them.

Whether a store can sell to buyers in a market (a storefront or a channel) through a business or legal entity other than the merchant, or through a merchant of record, and who sets it: the pages read state that agentic checkout keeps the merchant as merchant of record (S02-BC-351), and that the store profile's contact information (store display name, address, email, phone) can be set per storefront (S02-BC-112, S02-BC-308 to S02-BC-313); none names a business entity per storefront or market.
